scope.units: 1 KiB = 1024 bytes; UTF-8 source bytes including all comments and conditional branches

caveats: Guard-deduplicated sizes are reference transformations only, not compiled or validated submitted artifacts.
Include guards and SKIP_RUNTIME_CHECKS do not remove uploaded source bytes.
An all-source concatenation is a size scenario; it is not a recommendation to submit unrelated libraries.

Geometric standalone variants overlap the full geometry library; do not concatenate them all unless necessary.
